en.title: Lines found in mapping.txt of the AXFamily Next-Gen release build (Oct 9 recheck record)
items: gms.ads name shared with Legacy (compat classes)
en.note: A Next-Gen build still has 37 lines under com.google.android.gms.ads. Searching for that name would wrongly report Legacy.
en.alt: Bar chart: in mapping.txt of the AXFamily Next-Gen release build, the Next-Gen package name appears on 111 lines and compatibility classes under the gms.ads name shared with Legacy on 37.
